scripts.setup: npm run migrate && npm run install:all
scripts.tests: npm run test --prefix backend && npm run test --prefix frontend
scripts.lint: npm run lint --prefix backend && npm run lint --prefix frontend
scripts.install:all: npm instal && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.sidequest: concurrently --raw -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "npm run backend" "npm run frontend"
scripts.showcase: npm run migrate && npm run install:all && npm run sidequest
